notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few situations, where the game could get stuck on a black screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could undo the AI's moves.
[*] Fixed some missing text.
[*] Fixed some events and triggers after undoing moves.
[*] Added a confirmation window when attempting to erase game progress.
[*] Fixed having to RMB on a player after undoing a move to select him again.
[*] Fixed a bug, where a player with a high speed could move two times if his turn ended on passing the ball to the opponent.
[*] Fixed a issue causing the end turn window to be transparent.
[*] FIxed a issue with the cursor getting stuck when colliding with some objects.
[*] Fixed a issue where a newly loaded scene would pause for a few seconds.
[*] Fixed skill cooldown reset when restarting the game from the centre of the field.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with performance degradation.
- Removed "Delete data" from the main menu.
- Removed rare bug resulting in the enemy team not moving in their turn.
- Changed turn amount in PvP and PvE matches to 18.
- Shortened turn time to 120s in PvP.

notes.title: The studio behind Darkwood are making turn-based tactical football, and you can try it free now
notes.notes:
Following phenomenally frightful survival horror game Darkwood, Polish team Acid Wizard Studio are now making... a football game? They've just released a free public alpha for Soccer Kids, inviting everyone to try their turn-based tactical footie game starring schoolkids in 90s Poland. This is extremely not what I expected next from the studio whose debut game made Adam backtrack to kill his own dog "because the world is convincing and I didn't want to leave suffering animals lying around the place if I didn't have to." Come watch the trailer.
